user.title: Panasonic AW camera
user.description: Enter the camera's IP address. Username and password are only needed if user authentication is enabled on the camera.

error.invalid_auth: The camera rejected the username or password.
error.not_aw_camera: The device did not answer like a Panasonic AW camera.

ptz.name: Move (continuous)
ptz.description: Starts a continuous pan, tilt, zoom or focus move. Speeds are -100 to 100; 0 stops that axis. Without a duration the camera keeps moving until it is stopped.

pan.name: Pan speed
pan.description: Negative is left, positive is right.

tilt.name: Tilt speed
tilt.description: Negative is down, positive is up.

zoom.name: Zoom speed
zoom.description: Negative is wide, positive is tele.

focus.name: Focus speed
focus.description: Negative is near, positive is far.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Stop automatically after this many seconds.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stops all pan, tilt, zoom and focus movement.

preset_recall.name: Recall preset
preset_recall.description: Moves the camera to a saved preset.

preset_save.name: Save preset
preset_save.description: Saves the current position and picture settings to a preset.

move_absolute.name: Move to position
move_absolute.description: Moves to an absolute pan/tilt position in degrees and/or a zoom position in percent.

pan.name: Pan
pan.description: Pan angle in degrees (0 is centre).

tilt.name: Tilt
tilt.description: Tilt angle in degrees (0 is level, positive is up).

zoom.name: Zoom
zoom.description: Zoom position in percent (0 is wide).

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Sends any command from the Panasonic interface specification and returns the camera's answer.

interface.name: Interface
interface.description: ptz for pan/tilt head commands (aw_ptz, without the #), cam for camera commands (aw_cam).

command.name: Command
command.description: For example APC, R01, QGU or OGU:80.
